# Agent notes generated by the loop

`AGENTS.md` is human-authored and is never rewritten by an agent. This file carries
corrections and additions discovered during sprints, so the human-owned document stays the
document a human wrote.

## Server-side code that is not an endpoint

Nitro scans `api/`, `routes/`, `middleware/`, `plugins/` and `tasks/`, and auto-imports from
`utils/**`. A `.ts` file under `routes/` becomes an HTTP route whether or not it exports a
handler, so a shared server module must not be placed there. Capability modules get their own
top-level directory — `auth/` is the first — and that directory must not be named `utils`.

_Recorded during SWHM-S-0002 (change `swhm-i-0002-user-authentication-sign-on`)._

## Where a db-backed test file must live

`AGENTS.md` § Test & validate says route tests go in `routes/`, which was true when the only
db-touching code was a route. It now reads more precisely as: **a test that reaches
`db/client.ts` must run in Vitest's `server` project**, because the `client` (jsdom) project
cannot resolve `bun:sqlite` at all. The project is chosen by path in `vitest.config.ts`, so a
new server-side directory has to be added to the `server` project's `include` and the
`client` project's `exclude` when it is created.

_Recorded during SWHM-S-0002 (change `swhm-i-0002-user-authentication-sign-on`)._
